'''Youngite''' is an {{Uncommon}} collection item. As an ore, it has the appearance of light blue stained glass pane.

== Collection ==
Collecting '''Youngite''', {{Item|Timite}}, or {{Item|Obsolite}} increases the player's {{Item|Timite}} [[Collections|collection]], unlocking useful items and rewarding {{SkyBlock XP}} at specific milestones.

{{:Timite/Collection UI}}
{{CollectionTable|Timite}}

== Obtaining ==
'''Youngite''' can be obtained by breaking its ore with an {{Item|Anti-Sentient Pickaxe}} or its upgrades. Only {{Green|1}} '''Youngite''' will drop. 
* If replaced by a block of Air, it will take {{green|??}} {{More Info Needed|Can't figure it out. Been staring at a block of air for 3 minutes and nothing has spawned. How does this work ?}} seconds to regenerate.
* If replaced by a block of [[File:Blue Stained Glass Pane.png|21px|link=Timite]] [[Timite]] or [[File:Purple Stained Glass Pane.png|21px|link=Timite]] [[Obsolite]], it will take {{green|30}} seconds to regenerate.
